definitions.gloss: recapture; recovery; taking back by force
definitions.explanation: The act of recovering something that was taken or lost, often implying forceful or determined action. Used in military, sports, and political contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{領土|りょうど}→領土：15711_ryoudo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奪還|だっかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{首位|しゅい}→首位：14677_shui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奪還|だっかん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The team reclaimed the top spot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人質|ひとじち}→人質：09678_hitojichi⟧{奪還|だっかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An operation to recover the hostages was carried out.

notes:
USAGE:
{奪還|だっかん} implies forceful recovery of something important that was lost or taken. It is stronger and more dramatic than ⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧ (recovery) or ⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧ (to get back).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{領土|りょうど}→領土：15711_ryoudo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奪還|だっかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to recapture territory)
- ⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奪還|だっかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to retake political power)
- {奪還|だっかん}⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧ (recovery operation)
- ⟦タイトル→タイトル：03855_taitoru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奪還|だっかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to reclaim a title)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧ is more general and everyday, while {奪還|だっかん} implies something was wrongfully taken and is being recovered through determined effort or force.
